'''Kiffex''' was the smaller<ref name="Wizards" /> sister [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kiffu/Legends|Kiffu]] in the [[Azurbani system]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It had rich soil, giving Kiffex the potential to become a major agriculture producing planet.

It contained prison colonies for Kiffu's [[Sector/Legends|sector]], overseen by the [[Kiffu Guardians]], having served as a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] prison world since at least [[3000 BBY]]. Prior to that it was used as a prison colony for the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] during the [[Annexation of Kiffu|annexation of the system]]. In one of the many holding cells, the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Volfe Karkko]] was kept in a [[Stasis field/Legends|stasis field]]. In [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] accidentally released him. After that incident, the insane [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] overran the planet.

Kiffex was the home world of the infamous [[Tonnika sisters/Legends|Tonnika sisters]].

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Aaylapod.jpg|left|thumb|An [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] lands on Kiffex.]]

In [[Star Wars (1998) 20|''Star Wars'' (1998) 20]], the planet was repeatedly referred to as Kifex, a likely typo.

The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Kiffex in the [[Jospro sector/Legends|Jospro sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Additionally, ''Rebellion's'' encyclopedia entry for Kiffex describes the world as a recently colonized planet, which is seemingly contradictory to its history, especially considering its existence as an Inner Rim world.
